replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
- Mountains aren't overlayed with grass/dirt, making them seem bland and boring

- Houses are boxy & lack detail, use slabs & stairs and other blocks to add variation

- Lilipads in the water give one team an advantage. Make sure to mirror them properly. One team has lilipads bunched together while the other has barely any on one side.

- The river thing in the middle looks unnatural. Where the land meets the water, it should be jagged, not a straight line.

- The random boat?

- Poor terraforming on the mountains.

- The web traps.

- Add some variation and elevation the land, where's there are mountains the land around them isn't so flat.

- Snow on only some parts of the mountain, unfitting

- You should definitely add more to the mineshafts, maybe holes in the walls and obstructed structures?

- The majority of the map is water, which will lead to terribly boring and frustrating gameplay.

to conclude, i have never called anything you did shit and i am trying to help by pointing out what i think is wrong, but i guess for some reason calling the first version of a new map from a new mapmaker anything other than the greatest thing ever is being an ass.
